title: Optimistic pause/resume and remove of the business bot are not rolled back on error
trigger: In a private chat managed by a business bot press Stop (or Remove bot) while TDLib rejects the request (offline, flood, bot already removed).
effect: The bar shows 'bot paused' (or disappears) although the bot still runs; the error path only sets chats_state.chat_action_error, so the wrong bar stays until a later updateChatBusinessBotManageBar or reopening the app.
fix: Keep the bar as a Toggling{from,to} / Removing stage keyed by the request, and restore the previous bar in the ToggleBusinessBotPaused/RemoveBusinessBotFromChat error arms (src/state/domains/chats/error.rs:58).

title: Business bot bar flips/disappears locally and stays that way when the request fails
trigger: Pause/resume or remove the business bot in a chat and the request errors.
effect: toggle_business_bot_paused and remove_business_bot_from_chat call set_business_bot_bar right after sending; the ToggleBusinessBotPaused/RemoveBusinessBotFromChat error arms only set chat_action_error, so the bar shows the wrong paused state (or is gone) until the chat is re-parsed.
fix: Keep the old bar in the pending request and restore it on the error arm, or wait for updateChatBusinessBotManageBar.

title: Failed chat link delete keeps the row removed from the list
trigger: Delete a business chat link; deleteBusinessChatLink fails
effect: delete_chat_link removes the row optimistically; the error arm (business_extra.rs MutateChatLink) only sets the error text for Delete (no saving decrement, no re-ask: chat_links_requested stays true), so the link is hidden though it still exists
fix: Rollback of the removed row, or reset chat_links_requested in the Delete error arm so the list is asked again.

title: Protected-content rollback restores the flag but not the private_sharing disabled record
trigger: In a private chat turn sharing off and the request fails.
effect: set_chat_protected(previous) restores the flag, but private_sharing.record_disabled stays, so the chat shows 'you disabled sharing' for an unchanged chat.
fix: Put the record into the rollback or record it on success only.

title: Topic selection and history paging are keyed by session.open_chat/open_topic, single slots shared by every window
trigger: Open a forum topic in a chat window while the main window has another chat/topic open
effect: select_topic/fetch_topic_history/fetch_topic_history_newer/topic_jump_to_latest act on the main window's chat or fail with InvalidRequest, so the chat window's topic never pages
fix: Take (ChatId, topic) from the caller's ChatUi, not from the session.

title: check_pending/check_failed/check_generation are set before checkChatUsername and not cleared when the send fails
trigger: Type a link in the Type box when the send fails (client closing)
effect: The field shows checking with no request to answer it until the next keystroke
fix: enum UsernameCheck { Idle, Checking{generation,text}, Result{..}, Failed } set only after a successful send.

title: Revoke of a public link: if the second request fails to send, the first (username cleared) is already out and no revoke is recorded
trigger: Limit box > Revoke on a public community while the sender fails on the second send_json_request (disconnect between the two sends).
effect: setSupergroupUsername('') goes through but groups.group_type.revoke stays None and public_chats is not reset, so the list still shows the chat with a link it no longer has; the 'disable' pending entry leaks.
fix: Record PublicLinkRevoke before sending (or send both through one fallible step that rolls back) and reset public_chats on a partial send failure.

title: The rest of a basic-group Save is silently dropped when the upgraded chat is not known yet
trigger: Save the Type/Edit box of a basic group; the upgrade answers before upgraded_chat_for resolves
effect: Title, description, photo and link edits queued in EditAfterUpgrade are discarded with no error; the box already closed as saved
fix: Keep the EditAfterUpgrade until upgraded_chat_for resolves, or report an error when it cannot.

title: Channel membership probe runs only for session.open_chat, the main window's chat
trigger: Open a channel or supergroup in a chat window while the main window shows another chat
effect: my_member_status / my_rights_fetched are never fetched for it, so the composer gate and join/leave affordance use defaults
fix: Drive the probe from the set of chats shown in any window (ChatUi / WindowSlot).

title: A create guarded by purpose, not by dialog: closing the dialog mid-create leaves a silent no-op Create and an unexpected chat open
trigger: New group: fill name and members, press Create, close the dialog before TDLib answers, reopen New Group and press Create again
effect: create_new_chat returns Ok(None) while the first request is out and the UI ignores it (button does nothing); when the first answer arrives run_new_chat_created calls select_chat for the group although its dialog is gone; NewChatState.creations entries are never removed
fix: Key the in-flight create to the dialog (a Creating stage the closing dialog cancels or hands to a toast) and drop the creations entry when its answer is applied.

title: Saving the permissions box while an earlier setChatPermissions is in flight reports nothing sent and drops the new values
trigger: Change permissions, Save, reopen the box quickly, change again and Save before the first answer.
effect: set_chat_permissions returns Ok(None) on has_purpose_for_chat dedupe, so send_permissions_save reports Ok(false) (same as nothing differs) and the box closes as saved while the newer permissions were never sent.
fix: Return a distinct Busy outcome and keep the box open, or queue the second save.

title: The shared-media gallery and profile tabs are one session-wide SharedMediaState keyed by a single chat_id
trigger: Open the gallery in the main window, then open the gallery (or its profile tabs) in a chat window of another chat.
effect: fetch_profile_tabs, fetch_profile_tab and fetch_more_shared_media all read session.media.shared_media.chat_id; opening it in a second window replaces the first window's tabs and the answers are matched to the one chat only.
fix: Move the gallery into the per-window WindowSlot / per-chat ChatUi.

title: Require Monthly Fee can be switched on while editing an ordinary link and Save then wipes its limits
trigger: In a private channel edit an existing normal invite link, switch on Require Monthly Fee, press Save.
effect: offers_subscription ignores editing, so request() falls to InviteLinkRequest::Edit with expiration 0, member_limit 0 and no approval: the link silently loses its expiry, usage limit and approval and no fee is created.
fix: offers_subscription returns false when link.is_some() and locked_stars is None (tdesktop offers it for new links only).

title: A ringing conference invitation has no local expiry or way out except TDLib content updates
trigger: Receive an invitation, lose connection or miss the updateMessageContent for was_missed
effect: calls.conference_invite stays Some: ringtone keeps looping, further calls and invitations are declined as busy
fix: Store the ring start and drop the invite on tick after CONFERENCE_INVITE_RING_SECS (manual clock in tests)

title: A failed setChatMemberStatus / setChatMemberTag replaces the loaded administrators list with Failed
trigger: Open the Administrators page (list loaded), remove or restrict a member or set a custom title and the request fails (no rights, flood).
effect: admin_lists[chat] becomes AdminListFetch::Failed, so the page that showed administrators now shows 'Could not update member status' instead of the list, until it is refetched; the mutation error should go only to member_action_error.
fix: Keep the mutation error in member_action_error only (as invite_link_error does for link mutations) and leave admin_lists as Fetch<T>::Ready.

title: revoke_public_link can leave a half-sent revoke with no PublicLinkRevoke to settle it
trigger: In the public-links limit box press Revoke; setSupergroupUsername goes out, then the second send (disableAllSupergroupUsernames) fails.
effect: The function returns the error before group_type.revoke is set, so the first request's ok is unmatched: public_chats is not refreshed, the box still lists the chat as public although its link is gone, and the limit stays marked reached.
fix: Set revoke with the first request id before the second send and let a failed send settle it as failed.

title: The New Channel type step treats a lost or non-username failed save as success
trigger: Create a channel, in the Type step press Save; a request in saving (e.g. the join-by-request or no-forwards edit) errors, or is dropped without an answer.
effect: new_chat_facts only reads type_failed from info_edit_errors with field == Username and type_pending from requests.get; when all requests are gone and the error is of another field, the dialog advances to Subscribers as if saved.
fix: Record each Save request's outcome (Pending, Done, Failed) in NewChatCreation or the stage and derive the view from that, not from absence of a pending request.

title: A refused chat-link delete leaves the row gone and nothing refetches
trigger: Business > Chat Links: delete a link while offline or when TDLib refuses; connect delete_chat_link already dropped the row optimistically.
effect: The link vanishes from the list although it still exists; chat_links_requested stays true so the list is not asked for again until restart/reopen; only a toast-less error line appears.
fix: On the Delete error arm set chat_links_requested = false (or hold chat_links as Fetch<Vec<ChatLink>> and refetch on error) instead of keeping the optimistic removal.

title: Save error of a Business screen is lost when the box is closed right after leaving it
trigger: Business > Greeting, change and Back (save sent, hub shows 'Saving'), press Close before TDLib answers; TDLib refuses.
effect: The refusal goes to settings.business.error, drawn only inside the Business box. close_business_saving(true) closes at once on the hub and open_business clears the error, so the user never learns the save failed; the draft is gone too.
fix: Surface a failed save as a StatusNote when the box is closed (or keep Close disabled while saving is non-empty); one Save stage enum per screen.

title: Closing the Business box from a sub-screen drops the parent screen's draft unsaved
trigger: Business > Opening Hours, toggle days / change zone, open a weekday (Day) or the time zone list, press Esc or click the backdrop. Same from the recipients Picker (Greeting/Away/Chatbots) or the sticker picker (Start Page).
effect: close_business_saving runs business_leave for the current view only; Day/TimeZone/Picker/StickerPick/LinkEdit are not saves_on_leave, so Go(None) and close_business drops hours/greeting/away/chatbot/start_page drafts. Closing from the parent screen would have saved. Edits vanish with no note.
fix: Make business_leave walk up View::parent chain (save the nearest saving ancestor) or hold a stack of screens whose drafts each save on close.

title: 'Chat link saved.' shown before TDLib answers; a refused create/edit keeps the success note and loses the draft
trigger: Links to Chat > New link, fill it, Save when the link limit is reached or the server refuses.
effect: save_business_link goes back to the list and sets note 'Chat link saved.' as soon as the request is queued (doc says 'once TDLib answers'). The failure arrives later as a separate red line, the note stays, and the typed message/name draft (link_edit) is gone.
fix: Keep the LinkEdit view in a Saving stage (enum) until the apply_chat_link / error answer; show the note only on the ok arm.

title: Failed getBusinessConnectedBot leaves 'Loading…' forever with no Retry
trigger: Chat Automation opened while getBusinessConnectedBot fails (offline / server error other than 404).
effect: apply error sets connected_bot_requested=false; business_bot_pump reads that as failed, returns done and stops watching, but draft.loaded stays false so the body shows only 'Loading…' (business_waits_for_info excludes Chatbots, so no Retry button). Only leaving and re-entering retries. Also: failure is inferred from a bool going false, and SaveConnectedBot ok sets the same bool false, so the same signal means 'failed' and 'refetch wanted'.
fix: Make connected_bot a Fetch<Option<ConnectedBot>> (idle/loading/ready/failed) and draw the error with Retry like business_info_error.

title: Start page full-info fetch is re-sent on every render while the info is absent
trigger: Open an empty private chat with a user whose getUserFullInfo fails or never answers (deleted/restricted user), then move the mouse / any redraw.
effect: Comment says 'ask once' but no state records the ask: each render calls defer_screen -> fetch_user_full_info. It dedupes only while the request is pending or the info is stored; after an error nothing is stored, so each redraw sends the request again (request storm, no failure state).
fix: Track user full info as Fetch<UserFullInfo> per user with a Failed stage that stops re-asking until retry.

title: Closing the Business box drops the failed-send line of the screen it saved
trigger: Open Settings > Business > Away message, change it, press Esc (or the box's close button / backdrop) while the connection is down or the driver refuses the send. close_business_saving calls business_leave, whose business_send returns Leave::Go(Some("Could not send ...")); only Leave::Stay is looked at, so the Go note is dropped and the dialog closes. Same in demo mode (DEMO_LINE).
effect: The box closes as if the settings were saved; no toast, no status line. The edit is lost silently.
fix: Have close_business_saving post a StatusNote for Leave::Go(Some(line)) (as it does for Stay), or make Leave carry Saved / NotSent(line) and match both arms.

title: Dropped files or messages vanish silently when the chat does not open after the topic is picked
trigger: Drop files on a forum row, pick a topic; select_listed_chat is refused (agent_may_open false, route_chat_open returns None) or the forum has no window and the chat does not become open.
effect: choose_drop_topic has already set drop_topic = None and the box closes; enter_drop_topic returns false without a note on the 'chat not open' path, so the payload (paths or forward draft) is discarded with no feedback.
fix: Keep the payload until the open succeeds (a Choosing -> Opening -> Done enum) and set an error note on the false path.

title: A waiting ban has no way out and opens its warning over whatever is on screen
trigger: Choose Ban for a member, then close the moderation UI and open another box (or the member-chats ask never answers, e.g. reconnect leaves the Fetch Loading/Idle); later the answer lands
effect: drain_pending_ban calls show_community_box, replacing the unrelated open community box (an armed Requests undo is flushed), or the ban_wait stays set forever and pops the warning when that member's chats are asked again
fix: Make the wait a stage of the flow enum with a cancel (box close, chat change, lock) and a timeout/failed arm that ends it; open the warning only when no other box is open.

title: Confirm Ban, Remove, Create and Add close or stay silent when the driver refuses with Ok(None)
trigger: Community lost access (known_community false) while the box is open, then press Ban, Remove or Add; Create when the chat is no longer in the model
effect: confirm_community_ban and confirm_remove_from_community take the box then ignore Ok(None): the box closes as if done and nothing happened, no note; submit_new_community and send_add_community_chat likewise show no error and the button is not busy
fix: Treat Ok(None) from a send as a refused step: keep the box and post a note (as start_community_ban does with BanStart::Refused).

title: A failed chat list or joined-communities fetch is drawn as an empty list
trigger: Open Add a Chat to Community or the community picker while offline or with a TDLib error on getSuitableCommunityChats, getOwnedBots or getJoinedCommunities
effect: ProfileChatsFetch::Failed and Fetch::Failed map to an empty list: the chooser says no chats found and the picker shows only Create, with no error or retry
fix: Read the Fetch states into the view (Loading, Failed(error), Ready) and draw the error with a retry.

title: Recent actions search box keeps the previous chat's text when opened from Manage group
trigger: Type 'foo' into Recent actions of group A, close the box, open Manage > Recent actions of group B (group_edit_box/manage.rs only calls ensure_event_log_search, only the info-panel path syncs the value)
effect: Box shows 'foo' while B's list is unfiltered; the empty state/list do not match the visible text, and apply_event_log_search compares against B's stored empty query
fix: Sync the input value to the opened chat's stored query inside open_group_settings_view/RecentActions (one place), or own the search input per opened log.

title: Recent actions auto-load of older events is skipped when a new page has the same length as an earlier one (event_log_autoload never reset)
trigger: Open Recent actions, apply a search or filter that yields a short page with has_more (not scrollable), so autoload records its length; change the filter/search or reopen another chat or the same chat to get a page of the same length with has_more
effect: The older-events page is never requested (short lists never scroll, so the scroll hook cannot fire); the list shows a 'Loading older' spinner forever
fix: Key the marker by (ChatId, query/filter generation, len) or make it part of the per-page state and clear it in event_log_reset_list when the fetch leaves Loaded.

title: A failed fetch for the Invite Links, Join Requests or Administrators page shows the loading spinner for good
trigger: Open Group Settings > Invite Links (or Join Requests / Administrators) when the driver cannot send the request (Err is dropped by `let _ = match view`).
effect: The session never gets a Loading/Failed entry, and the sections draw None the same as Loading (spinner). Only the small refresh icon recovers; no error and no Retry button.
fix: Treat an Err from the fetch as Fetch::Failed in the session, and draw None as 'not asked' (ask again) rather than as Loading.
